question: Beri peringkat tiap deal lost berdasarkan nilainya dari yang terbesar.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, rank() OVER (ORDER BY d.value DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost' ORDER BY peringkat

question: kasih nomor urut tiket urgent dari yg paling baru dibuat
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY t.created_at DESC) AS nomor_urut FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' ORDER BY nomor_urut

question: Tampilkan aktivitas call beserta peringkat tanpa celah berdasarkan durasi terlama.
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, a.duration_minutes, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY a.duration_minutes DESC) AS peringkat_durasi FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'call' ORDER BY peringkat_durasi

question: Hitung total durasi kumulatif aktivitas tiap sales berdasarkan urutan waktu.
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, a.duration_minutes, sum(a.duration_minutes) OVER (PARTITION BY a.rep_id ORDER BY a.timestamp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS durasi_kumulatif FROM activities AS a

question: tiap deal + nilai terkecil di stage yg sama dong
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, min(d.value) OVER (PARTITION BY d.stage) AS nilai_terkecil_stage FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: Tampilkan tiket resolved, waktu penyelesaiannya, dan rata-rata waktu penyelesaian untuk prioritas yang sama.
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, t.resolution_time_hours, round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours) OVER (PARTITION BY t.priority), 2) AS rata_rata_prioritas FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status = 'resolved' AND t.resolution_time_hours IS NOT NULL

question: Berapa selisih nilai tiap deal won dengan rata-rata nilai seluruh deal won?
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, round(d.value - avg(d.value) OVER (), 2) AS selisih_dari_rata_rata FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won'

question: Bagi deal won jadi 4 kuartil berdasarkan nilainya.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, ntile(4) OVER (ORDER BY d.value) AS kuartil FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won'

question: bagi pelanggan jadi 5 kelompok sama besar menurut tanggal daftar
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, c.created_at, ntile(5) OVER (ORDER BY c.created_at) AS kelompok FROM customers AS c FINAL

question: Persentase durasi tiap meeting terhadap total durasi meeting milik sales yang sama?

question: Tampilkan pelanggan beserta jumlah pelanggan dengan status yang sama.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, count() OVER (PARTITION BY c.status) AS jumlah_status_sama FROM customers AS c FINAL

question: Rangking deal negotiation berdasarkan probability, tertinggi di atas.

question: Tampilkan 2 aktivitas terlama (durasi) untuk setiap pelanggan.

question: 5 deal pipeline dengan nilai tertinggi untuk masing-masing stage?

question: Rekap omset per bulan tahun ini beserta omset kumulatif tahun berjalan.

question: Omset bulanan tiap wilayah sales dengan total kumulatif per wilayah.

question: rata-rata bergerak 3 bulan untuk jumlah tiket baru per bulan

question: Kontribusi persen tiap deal won terhadap total omset tim sales-nya.

question: Peringkat segmen pelanggan berdasarkan jumlah pelanggan aktif.

question: Tampilkan jumlah tiket per bulan untuk 12 bulan terakhir dan selisihnya dari rata-rata bulanan.

question: Tampilkan deal won, nilainya, plus nilai min, max, dan rata-rata deal won di segmen pelanggan yang sama.

question: Peringkat pelanggan berdasarkan jumlah tiket yang pernah dibuat, tampilkan peringkat 1 sampai 10 (tanpa celah).

question: Dari tiket yg dibuat tiap pelanggan, ambil 2 yang paling baru, hanya prioritas high atau urgent.

question: Tampilkan deal terbesar tiap pelanggan Enterprise.

question: Persentase tiket tiap prioritas terhadap seluruh tiket, urut dari terbanyak.

question: Jumlah pelanggan baru per bulan dan totalnya berjalan sejak awal data.

question: Tampilkan 3 deal won terbesar tiap sales beserta nama sales-nya.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, r.name AS rep_name FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.rep_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id ORDER BY d.value DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won') AS x INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON x.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE x.rn <= 3 ORDER BY x.rep_id, x.value DESC

question: Pelanggan yang deal terakhirnya berstatus negotiation, tampilkan juga nama perusahaannya.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, c.company FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.customer_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.created_date DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL) AS x INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON x.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE x.rn = 1 AND x.stage = 'negotiation'

question: Siapa saja pelanggan yang tiket terbarunya masih urgent? Tampilkan id dan nama.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM (SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.created_at DESC) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL) AS x INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON x.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE x.rn = 1 AND x.priority = 'urgent'

question: Omset bulanan per tim sales tahun ini, dengan omset kumulatif per tim dan peringkat bulan di dalam tim.
sql: SELECT r.team, toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY bulan) AS omset_kumulatif, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat_bulan FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.team, bulan ORDER BY r.team, bulan

question: Rekap tiket per bulan: jumlah, rata-rata bergerak 3 bulan, dan persen terhadap total tiket seluruh bulan.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_tiket, round(avg(count()) OVER (ORDER BY bulan ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS rata_rata_bergerak, round(count() / sum(count()) OVER (), 2) AS persen_total FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Dari sales dengan omset won terbesar di tiap wilayah sales, tampilkan wilayah, id, nama, dan omsetnya.
sql: SELECT x.region, x.rep_id, x.name, x.omset FROM (SELECT r.region, r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS omset, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.region, r.rep_id, r.name) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1 ORDER BY x.region

question: Perusahaan peringkat 1 sampai 3 berdasarkan jumlah tiket di tiap tier pelanggan, peringkat tanpa celah.
sql: SELECT x.tier, x.company, x.jumlah_tiket FROM (SELECT c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, c.company, count() AS jumlah_tiket, dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY tier ORDER BY count() DESC) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY tier, c.company) AS x WHERE x.rn <= 3 ORDER BY x.tier, x.jumlah_tiket DESC

question: Bulan dengan omset terbesar di tiap tahun, tampilkan tahun, bulan, omset.
sql: SELECT x.tahun, x.bulan, x.omset FROM (SELECT toYear(d.closed_date) AS tahun, toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY tahun ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY tahun, bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1 ORDER BY x.tahun

question: Tampilkan 2 deal won terbesar tiap pelanggan Enterprise, beserta nama pelanggan dan nama sales-nya.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, c.name AS customer_name, r.name AS rep_name FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.customer_id, d.rep_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.value DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won') AS x INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON x.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON x.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE x.rn <= 2 AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' ORDER BY x.customer_id, x.value DESC

question: Ranking pelanggan berdasarkan jumlah aktivitas positif, tampilkan peringkat 1-5 pakai rank (jika seri bisa lebih dari 5).
sql: SELECT x.customer_id, x.name, x.jumlah_positif, x.peringkat FROM (SELECT c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name AS name, count() AS jumlah_positif, rank() OVER (ORDER BY count() DESC) AS peringkat FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE a.sentiment = 'positive' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name) AS x WHERE x.peringkat <= 5 ORDER BY x.peringkat, x.customer_id

question: Tiap pelanggan: deal won terbesarnya dan persen nilainya terhadap total won pelanggan itu.
sql: SELECT x.customer_id, x.name, x.nilai_terbesar, round(x.nilai_terbesar / x.total_won, 2) AS persen_terbesar FROM (SELECT c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name AS name, d.value AS nilai_terbesar, sum(d.value) OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_id) AS total_won, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_id ORDER BY d.value DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won') AS x WHERE x.rn = 1

question: Omset won tiap sales per bulan di tahun ini dan selisihnya dengan rata-rata omset bulanan sales itu sendiri.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, round(sum(d.value) - avg(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.rep_id), 2) AS selisih_rata_rata_sales FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name, bulan ORDER BY r.rep_id, bulan

question: Cari pelanggan yang jumlah tiketnya ada di kuartil teratas (ntile 4 = 1) di antara semua pelanggan bertiket.
sql: SELECT x.customer_id, x.name, x.jumlah_tiket FROM (SELECT c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name AS name, count() AS jumlah_tiket, ntile(4) OVER (ORDER BY count() DESC) AS kuartil FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name) AS x WHERE x.kuartil = 1 ORDER BY x.jumlah_tiket DESC

question: Persentase omset won tiap produk dari total omset seluruh produk, dengan peringkatnya.
sql: SELECT arrayJoin(d.products_involved) AS produk, sum(d.value) AS omset, round(sum(d.value) / sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (), 2) AS persen_omset, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY produk ORDER BY peringkat

question: Untuk tiap wilayah pelanggan, 3 pelanggan dengan omset won tertinggi.
sql: SELECT x.wilayah, x.customer_id, x.name, x.omset FROM (SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name AS name, sum(d.value) AS omset, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY wilayah ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY wilayah, c.customer_id, c.name) AS x WHERE x.rn <= 3 ORDER BY x.wilayah, x.omset DESC

question: Rata-rata bergerak 3 bulan omset won per wilayah sales, tampilkan wilayah, bulan, omset, rata-rata bergerak.
sql: SELECT r.region, toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, round(avg(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region ORDER BY bulan ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS omset_rata_rata_bergerak FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.region, bulan ORDER BY r.region, bulan

question: Aktivitas demo terakhir tiap pelanggan, tampilkan juga nama pelanggan dan nama sales.
sql: SELECT x.activity_id, x.customer_id, x.rep_id, x.type, x.timestamp, c.name AS customer_name, r.name AS rep_name FROM (SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'demo') AS x INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON x.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON x.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE x.rn = 1

question: Pelanggan yang aktivitas terakhirnya (apapun tipenya) bersentimen negative: id dan nama saja.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM (SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, a.sentiment, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM activities AS a) AS x INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON x.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE x.rn = 1 AND x.sentiment = 'negative'

question: Tampilkan jumlah deal won per sales per bulan, peringkatkan sales di dalam tiap bulan (dense rank), bulan tahun ini saja.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_won, dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY bulan ORDER BY count() DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan, r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY bulan, peringkat, r.rep_id

question: Hitung persentase pertumbuhan omset won bulanan dibanding bulan sebelumnya untuk tahun lalu, buang bulan pertama.
sql: SELECT x.bulan, x.omset, round((x.omset - x.omset_sebelumnya) / x.omset_sebelumnya, 2) AS pertumbuhan FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, lagInFrame(sum(d.value)) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS omset_sebelumnya, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.bulan

question: Deal pipeline terbesar tiap sales di tiap stage, pakai nomor urut.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, x.rep_id FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.rep_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id, d.stage ORDER BY d.value DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1 ORDER BY x.rep_id, x.stage

question: 2 tiket open terbaru tiap pelanggan, dan tampilkan nama perusahaannya.
sql: SELECT x.ticket_id, x.customer_id, x.priority, x.status, x.created_at, c.company FROM (SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.created_at DESC) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status = 'open') AS x INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON x.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE x.rn <= 2

question: Sales dengan win rate tertinggi di timnya (rank), tampilkan tim, id, nama, win rate untuk peringkat 1.
sql: SELECT x.team, x.rep_id, x.name, x.win_rate FROM (SELECT r.team, r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team, r.rep_id, r.name HAVING countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) > 0) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1 ORDER BY x.team

question: Tampilkan jumlah tiket per prioritas tiap bulan, dengan persentase tiap prioritas terhadap total tiket bulan itu.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, t.priority, count() AS jumlah_tiket, round(count() / sum(count()) OVER (PARTITION BY bulan), 2) AS persen_bulan FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY bulan, t.priority ORDER BY bulan, t.priority

question: Hari dalam seminggu (nomor hari) diurutkan dari yang aktivitasnya paling banyak, beri peringkat tanpa celah.
sql: SELECT toDayOfWeek(a.timestamp) AS hari_ke, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY count() DESC) AS peringkat FROM activities AS a GROUP BY hari_ke ORDER BY peringkat, hari_ke

question: Deal won terbesar kedua tiap sales, tampilkan id, judul, stage, nilai.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id ORDER BY d.value DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won') AS x WHERE x.rn = 2

question: Siapa pelanggan Mid-Market yang total omsetnya di atas rata-rata omset semua pelanggan Mid-Market? Sertakan omset dan selisihnya.
sql: SELECT x.customer_id, x.name, x.omset, round(x.omset - x.rata_rata, 2) AS selisih FROM (SELECT c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name AS name, sum(d.value) AS omset, avg(sum(d.value)) OVER () AS rata_rata FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.segment = 'Mid-Market' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name) AS x WHERE x.omset > x.rata_rata ORDER BY x.omset DESC

question: Omset won kumulatif tiap sales per bulan di tahun ini, serta persen omset kumulatif itu terhadap total omset sales tersebut tahun ini.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.rep_id ORDER BY bulan) AS omset_kumulatif, round(omset_kumulatif / sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.rep_id), 2) AS persen_kumulatif FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name, bulan ORDER BY r.rep_id, bulan

question: Dua tiket resolved paling lama diselesaikan oleh tiap pelanggan.
sql: SELECT x.ticket_id, x.customer_id, x.priority, x.status, x.created_at, x.resolution_time_hours FROM (SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, t.resolution_time_hours, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.resolution_time_hours DESC) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status = 'resolved' AND t.resolution_time_hours IS NOT NULL) AS x WHERE x.rn <= 2

question: Berapa persen omset won tiap segmen terhadap total omset di masing-masing wilayah pelanggan?
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, c.segment, sum(d.value) AS omset, round(sum(d.value) / sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY wilayah), 2) AS persen_wilayah FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY wilayah, c.segment ORDER BY wilayah, c.segment

question: Pelanggan yang deal terbarunya (berdasarkan tanggal dibuat) berstatus won dengan nilai di atas 400 ribu, tampilkan nama pelanggan juga.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, c.name AS customer_name FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.customer_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.created_date DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL) AS x INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON x.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE x.rn = 1 AND x.stage = 'won' AND x.value > 400000

question: Tampilkan rata-rata bergerak 3 bulan untuk jumlah tiket urgent tiap bulan setahun terakhir.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_urgent, round(avg(count()) OVER (ORDER BY bulan ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS rata_rata_bergerak FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.created_at >= subtractMonths(now(), 12) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Rangking tim sales berdasarkan omset tahun ini, plus selisih omset tiap tim dengan rata-rata omset tim.
sql: SELECT r.team, sum(d.value) AS omset, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat, round(sum(d.value) - avg(sum(d.value)) OVER (), 2) AS selisih_rata_rata FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY peringkat

question: Untuk tiap sales, bulan dengan jumlah deal won paling banyak (satu bulan saja per sales).
sql: SELECT x.rep_id, x.name, x.bulan, x.jumlah_won FROM (SELECT r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name, toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_won, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.rep_id ORDER BY count() DESC, bulan) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name, bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1 ORDER BY x.rep_id

question: Tiap deal pipeline ditampilkan bersama peringkatnya berdasarkan weighted value (value * probability / 100) di dalam sales yang sama.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.rep_id, d.value * d.probability / 100 AS nilai_tertimbang, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id ORDER BY d.value * d.probability / 100 DESC) AS peringkat_sales FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') ORDER BY d.rep_id, peringkat_sales

question: pelanggan Enterprise yg tiket terakhirnya masih open/in_progress, kasih id, nama, sama prioritas tiketnya
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, x.priority FROM (SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.created_at DESC) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL) AS x INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON x.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE x.rn = 1 AND x.status IN ('open','in_progress') AND c.segment = 'Enterprise'

question: Jumlah deal baru per bulan dan persen kumulatifnya terhadap total deal seluruh periode.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.created_date) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_deal, round(sum(count()) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) / sum(count()) OVER (), 2) AS persen_kumulatif FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: 2 produk dengan omset won tertinggi di tiap wilayah pelanggan.
sql: SELECT x.wilayah, x.produk, x.omset FROM (SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, arrayJoin(d.products_involved) AS produk, sum(d.value) AS omset, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY wilayah ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY wilayah, produk) AS x WHERE x.rn <= 2 ORDER BY x.wilayah, x.omset DESC

question: Sales yang jumlah aktivitasnya masuk kuartil terbawah (ntile 4 urut naik = 1), tampilkan id, nama, jumlah aktivitas.
sql: SELECT x.rep_id, x.name, x.jumlah_aktivitas FROM (SELECT r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name AS name, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, ntile(4) OVER (ORDER BY count()) AS kuartil FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name) AS x WHERE x.kuartil = 1 ORDER BY x.jumlah_aktivitas

question: Tampilkan deal won beserta nilai deal won sebelumnya milik pelanggan yang sama (urut tanggal closing), buang yang tidak punya sebelumnya.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, x.nilai_sebelumnya FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, lagInFrame(d.value) OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.closed_date) AS nilai_sebelumnya, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.closed_date) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won') AS x WHERE x.rn > 1

question: Siapa sales yang omset won bulan lalunya peringkat 1-3 di timnya? Tampilkan tim, id, nama, omset.
sql: SELECT x.team, x.rep_id, x.name, x.omset FROM (SELECT r.team, r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS omset, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY r.team, r.rep_id, r.name) AS x WHERE x.rn <= 3 ORDER BY x.team, x.omset DESC

question: 3 jam tersibuk (toHour) berdasarkan jumlah aktivitas call, sertakan persen dari total call.
sql: SELECT x.jam, x.jumlah_call, x.persen_call FROM (SELECT toHour(a.timestamp) AS jam, count() AS jumlah_call, round(count() / sum(count()) OVER (), 2) AS persen_call, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY count() DESC) AS rn FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'call' GROUP BY jam) AS x WHERE x.rn <= 3 ORDER BY x.rn

question: Tiap pelanggan aktif yang punya deal won: tanggal closing deal won pertamanya.
sql: SELECT x.customer_id, x.name, x.closed_date AS won_pertama FROM (SELECT c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name AS name, d.closed_date, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_id ORDER BY d.closed_date) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.status = 'active') AS x WHERE x.rn = 1

question: Deal paling baru tiap tim sales (berdasarkan tanggal dibuat), tampilkan juga nama tim.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, x.team FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, r.team AS team, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY d.created_date DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1

question: Omset kumulatif sepanjang tahun ini per segmen pelanggan, per bulan.
sql: SELECT c.segment, toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment ORDER BY bulan) AS omset_kumulatif FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY c.segment, bulan ORDER BY c.segment, bulan

question: Rangking sales berdasarkan jumlah pelanggan unik yang ditangani lewat aktivitas, tanpa celah.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, uniqExact(a.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY uniqExact(a.customer_id) DESC) AS peringkat FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY peringkat, r.rep_id

question: Pelanggan dengan deal terakhir (terbaru dibuat) berstatus lost, plus nilai total won pelanggan itu sepanjang waktu. Tampilkan id, nama, total won.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, w.total_won FROM (SELECT d.customer_id AS customer_id, d.stage AS stage, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.created_date DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL) AS x INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON x.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id AS customer_id, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won') AS total_won FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS w ON x.customer_id = w.customer_id WHERE x.rn = 1 AND x.stage = 'lost'

question: Selisih jumlah tiket tiap bulan dengan bulan sebelumnya selama 12 bulan terakhir (tanpa bulan pertama).
sql: SELECT x.bulan, x.jumlah_tiket, x.jumlah_tiket - x.bulan_sebelumnya AS selisih FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_tiket, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS bulan_sebelumnya, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= subtractMonths(now(), 12) GROUP BY bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.bulan

question: Peringkat (dense_rank) pelanggan di tiap tier berdasarkan omset won, ambil peringkat 1 saja, tampilkan tier, id, nama, omset.
sql: SELECT x.tier, x.customer_id, x.name, x.omset FROM (SELECT c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name AS name, sum(d.value) AS omset, dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY tier ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY tier, c.customer_id, c.name) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1 ORDER BY x.tier

question: Tampilkan 5 aktivitas terbaru tiap sales dalam 7 hari terakhir, dengan nama sales.
sql: SELECT x.activity_id, x.customer_id, x.rep_id, x.type, x.timestamp, r.name AS rep_name FROM (SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.rep_id ORDER BY a.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 7)) AS x INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON x.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE x.rn <= 5 ORDER BY x.rep_id, x.timestamp DESC

question: Pelanggan yang tiket paling barunya sudah resolved atau closed, tapi punya minimal 1 tiket urgent sepanjang waktu: id dan nama.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM (SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, countIf(t.priority = 'urgent') OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id) AS jumlah_urgent, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.created_at DESC) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL) AS x INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON x.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE x.rn = 1 AND x.status IN ('resolved','closed') AND x.jumlah_urgent >= 1

question: Persentase omset won tiap sales terhadap total omset timnya, hanya untuk tim Inbound, urut dari yang terbesar.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS omset, round(sum(d.value) / sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.team), 2) AS persen_tim FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND r.team = 'Inbound' GROUP BY r.team, r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY persen_tim DESC

question: Peringkat produk di tiap segmen pelanggan berdasarkan jumlah deal won yang menyertakannya, ambil 3 teratas (nomor urut).
sql: SELECT x.segment, x.produk, x.jumlah_deal FROM (SELECT c.segment, arrayJoin(d.products_involved) AS produk, count() AS jumlah_deal, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment ORDER BY count() DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.segment, produk) AS x WHERE x.rn <= 3 ORDER BY x.segment, x.jumlah_deal DESC

question: Rata-rata bergerak 3 bulan untuk rata-rata durasi aktivitas per bulan, tahun lalu.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(a.timestamp) AS bulan, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_rata_durasi, round(avg(avg(a.duration_minutes)) OVER (ORDER BY bulan ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS rata_rata_bergerak FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND a.timestamp < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Sales yang omset won-nya di atas rata-rata omset sales di timnya sendiri: tampilkan tim, id, nama, omset.
sql: SELECT x.team, x.rep_id, x.name, x.omset FROM (SELECT r.team AS team, r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name AS name, sum(d.value) AS omset, avg(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.team) AS rata_rata_tim FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team, r.rep_id, r.name) AS x WHERE x.omset > x.rata_rata_tim ORDER BY x.team, x.omset DESC

question: Pelanggan aktif dengan deal pipeline terbesar tiap pelanggan, tampilkan hanya yang nilainya di atas rata-rata deal pipeline semua pelanggan itu.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.value DESC) AS rn, avg(d.value) OVER () AS rata_rata FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND c.status = 'active') AS x WHERE x.rn = 1 AND x.value > x.rata_rata

question: Tampilkan 2 pelanggan dengan jumlah deal won terbanyak di tiap tier.
sql: SELECT x.tier, x.customer_id, x.name, x.jumlah_won FROM (SELECT c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name AS name, count() AS jumlah_won, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY tier ORDER BY count() DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY tier, c.customer_id, c.name) AS x WHERE x.rn <= 2 ORDER BY x.tier, x.jumlah_won DESC

question: brp omset won tiap kuartal dan persen kumulatifnya thd total tahun itu?
sql: SELECT toStartOfQuarter(d.closed_date) AS kuartal, sum(d.value) AS omset, round(sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY toYear(kuartal) ORDER BY kuartal) / sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY toYear(kuartal)), 2) AS persen_kumulatif FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY kuartal ORDER BY kuartal

question: Rekap jumlah aktivitas per tipe dengan peringkatnya (rank), urut dari terbanyak.
sql: SELECT a.type, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, rank() OVER (ORDER BY count() DESC) AS peringkat FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type ORDER BY peringkat

question: Tiap deal won dengan nilai tertinggi di tiap tahun closing, ambil 3 teratas per tahun.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, x.tahun FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, toYear(d.closed_date) AS tahun, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY toYear(d.closed_date) ORDER BY d.value DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won') AS x WHERE x.rn <= 3 ORDER BY x.tahun, x.value DESC

question: Tampilkan tiket dengan nomor urut per pelanggan sesuai waktu pembuatan, khusus pelanggan Enterprise.
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.created_at) AS nomor_urut FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise' ORDER BY t.customer_id, nomor_urut

question: persentase omset won tiap bulan di tahun ini terhadap total omset tahun ini
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, round(sum(d.value) / sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (), 2) AS persen_tahun FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Peringkat pelanggan menurut jumlah tiket urgent, nilai sama peringkat sama.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_urgent, rank() OVER (ORDER BY count() DESC) AS peringkat FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY peringkat, c.customer_id

question: Nilai deal lost tertinggi dan terendah tiap sales ditampilkan di samping tiap deal lost-nya.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.rep_id, max(d.value) OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id) AS nilai_tertinggi_sales, min(d.value) OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id) AS nilai_terendah_sales FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost'

question: Pelanggan yang aktivitas pertamanya adalah demo, tampilkan id dan nama pelanggan.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM (SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp) AS rn FROM activities AS a) AS x INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON x.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE x.rn = 1 AND x.type = 'demo'

question: Hitung selisih hari antara tiap tiket dan tiket sebelumnya dari pelanggan yang sama, buang tiket pertama tiap pelanggan.
sql: SELECT x.ticket_id, x.customer_id, x.priority, x.status, x.created_at, dateDiff('day', x.tiket_sebelumnya, x.created_at) AS selisih_hari FROM (SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, lagInFrame(t.created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.created_at) AS tiket_sebelumnya, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.created_at) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1

question: Sales terbaik (omset won tertinggi) tiap bulan di tahun ini: bulan, id, nama, omset.
sql: SELECT x.bulan, x.rep_id, x.name, x.omset FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name AS name, sum(d.value) AS omset, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY bulan ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan, r.rep_id, r.name) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1 ORDER BY x.bulan

question: Tampilkan deal won tiap pelanggan Mid-Market beserta total omset kumulatif segmen itu berdasarkan tanggal closing dan nama pelanggan.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, c.name AS customer_name, d.closed_date, sum(d.value) OVER (ORDER BY d.closed_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS omset_kumulatif_segmen FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.segment = 'Mid-Market' ORDER BY d.closed_date

question: Siapa sales dengan jumlah deal won terbanyak di timnya (rank, seri ikut tampil)? Tampilkan tim, id, nama, jumlah won, untuk peringkat 1 saja.
sql: SELECT x.team, x.rep_id, x.name, x.jumlah_won FROM (SELECT r.team AS team, r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name AS name, count() AS jumlah_won, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY count() DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team, r.rep_id, r.name) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1 ORDER BY x.team, x.rep_id

question: Omset won bulanan tahun ini dan peringkat dense bulan terbaik, plus persen terhadap bulan terbaik.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat, round(sum(d.value) / max(sum(d.value)) OVER (), 2) AS rasio_terbaik FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Tampilkan 2 aktivitas call terpanjang untuk tiap pelanggan aktif, beserta nama pelanggan.
sql: SELECT x.activity_id, x.customer_id, x.rep_id, x.type, x.timestamp, x.duration_minutes, c.name AS customer_name FROM (SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, a.duration_minutes, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.duration_minutes DESC) AS rn FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'call') AS x INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON x.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE x.rn <= 2 AND c.status = 'active'
